# Properties

## 🏗️ Build

### `generate_javadocs_jar`

If true, Gradle will also generate a Javadocs jar whenever you build your project.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

### `generate_source_jar`

If true, Gradle will also generate a sources jar whenever you build your project.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

## 🔭 Integration - AssetMover

### `use_assetmover`

Convenient way to allow downloading of assets from official vanilla Minecraft servers, CurseForge, or any direct links. Also check the [Documentation](https://github.com/CleanroomMC/AssetMover).

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `assetmover_version`

Provided by the template via `gradle.properties`

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** yes
- **Default:** none

## 🔭 Integration - Better Config

### `use_betterconfig`

BetterConfig extends Forge's annotation-based config system to support nested arrays, collections, arrays/collections/maps of objects, and much more. Also check the [Documentation](https://github.com/Meldexun/BetterConfig/blob/main/README.md)

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `betterconfig_version`

Provided by the template via `gradle.properties`

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** yes
- **Default:** none

## 🔭 Integration - GroovyScript

### `use_groovyscript`

Allows modpack creators to change recipes and other game objects via [Groovy](https://github.com/apache/groovy)

- **Type:** Boolean

### `groovyscript_version`

Provided by the template via `gradle.properties`

### `grs_disable_cache`

Should GroovyScript cache changes to improve load time?

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `grs_generate_and_crash`

Should the game crash after generating the wiki page and/or example scripts?

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `grs_generate_examples`

Should example scripts from other loaded mods be generated in the 'examples' folder?

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `grs_generate_wiki`

Should the corresponding wiki page be generated when executing the 'runClient' task?

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

### `grs_log_missing_lang_keys`

Should missing language keys be logged to the mod log?

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

### `grs_run_ls`

Should the GroovyScript language server be run when executing the 'runClient' task?

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `grs_use_examples_folder`

Instead of using the GroovyScript folder in run/groovyscript, use the 'examples' folder instead.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

## 🌍 Minecraft

### `minecraft_version`

The version of Minecraft to use. This should only ever be `1.12.2` and changing this may lead to unexpected issues.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `1.12.2`

### `DEV_USERNAME`

Can be used to set the player name

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** none
- **Environment variable:** `DEV_USERNAME` takes precedence over the property

### `minecraft_username`

This can also be set via the `DEV_USERNAME` variable.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `Developer`

## 🗺️ Project

### `mod_authors`

Authors of the mod. Separate multiple authors with commas.

- **Type:** List (delimiter `","`)
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** empty list

### `mod_credits`

Credits for the mod.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `Ender-Development.org`

### `mod_description`

A short description of your mod.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `""`

### `mod_id`

The mod id is a unique identifier for your mod. It must be all lowercase and contain no spaces.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** yes
- **Default:** none

### `mod_logo_path`

The logo path for the mod. This should be a path to a PNG file within the assets folder of your mod.

- **Type:** Evaluated String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `assets/${mod_id}/textures/logo.png`

### `mod_name`

The mod name is the display name for your mod. This can contain spaces and capitalization.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** yes
- **Default:** none

### `mod_url`

The URL to the homepage of the mod or its git repository.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** yes
- **Default:** none

### `root_package`

The root package for your mod's main class. Change this to your own package. This should match the directory structure of your main class.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `org.ender_development`

## 📰 Publishing

### `additional_dependencies`

Project names that should be added as 'required'. Mods with build-in integration except the ones from `dependencies.properties` are taken care of automatically.

- **Type:** List (delimiter `" "`)
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** empty list

### `is_client_side`

Set to false if your mod is server-side only. Used to set environment on CurseForge and Modrinth.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

### `is_server_side`

Set to false if your mod is client-side only. Used to set environment on CurseForge and Modrinth.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

### `moddex_id`

The Moddex.gg ID of your project.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `""`

### `release_type`

Must be one of [`release`, `beta`, `alpha`]!

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `release`

## 📰 Publishing - CurseForge

### `curseforge_debug`

Enable debug mode. Simulating a file upload, without actually pushing anything.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `curseforge_id`

CurseForge project ID must be the numerical ID and not the slug

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `""`

### `CURSEFORGE_TOKEN`

CurseForge API Token to publish builds straight from your IDE. [Read their API Documentation](https://support.curseforge.com/en/support/solutions/articles/9000197321-curseforge-api)

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** none
- **Environment variable:** `CURSEFORGE_TOKEN` takes precedence over the property

### `publish_to_curseforge`

Enable features related to publishing to CurseForge

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

## 📰 Publishing - Maven

### `maven_name`

The name of the file you want to publish

- **Type:** Evaluated String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `${mod_id}`

### `MAVEN_PASSWORD`

Password to authenticate Maven access

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** none
- **Environment variable:** `MAVEN_PASSWORD` takes precedence over the property

### `maven_url`

URL of the maven you want to publish on

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `https://maven.ender-development.org`

### `MAVEN_USERNAME`

Name used to upload files to the Maven specified by `maven_url`

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** none
- **Environment variable:** `MAVEN_USERNAME` takes precedence over the property

## 📰 Publishing - Modrinth

### `modrinth_debug`

Enable debug mode. Simulating a file upload, without actually pushing anything.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `modrinth_id`

The Modrinth ID of your project

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `""`

### `modrinth_sync_readme`

Allows Gradle to sync the README.md to the Modrinth project body

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no

### `MODRINTH_TOKEN`

Modrinth API Token to publish builds straight from your IDE. The token must have the `CREATE_VERSION` and `PROJECT_WRITE` permissions. [Read their API Documentaion](https://docs.modrinth.com/)

- **Required:** no
- **Default:** none
- **Environment variable:** `MODRINTH_TOKEN` takes precedence over the property

### `publish_to_modrinth`

Enable features related to publishing to Modrinth

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

## 📖 README.md

### `license`

The license this project is published under.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `All Rights Reserved`, `LGPL-3.0-only`

### `partnership`

A section about a partnership if there is one to promote. Use `<br>` for linebreak. An example can be found in the `project.properties`.

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `""`

### `readme`

A longer description about the features of this mod. Use `<br>` for linebreak. An example can be found in the `project.properties`.

- **Type:** Evaluated String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `${mod_description}`

## 🛠️ Utility - .editorconfig

### `disable_editorconfig`

Use this to prevent the buildscripts from overriding your `.editorconfig` file

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `editorconfig`

Must be on of [`roz`, `spotless`].

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `spotless`

## 🛠️ Utility - Access Transformers

### `use_access_transformer`

A way to change visibility of Minecraft's classes, methods and fields. AT files should be in the root of src/main/resources with the filename formatted as: `${mod_id}_at.cfg`

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `use_dependency_at_files`

If true, dependencies will be scanned for AT files and applied automatically

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

### `access_transformer_location`

Change location and name of the AT file

- **Type:** Evaluated String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `${mod_id}_at.cfg`

## 🛠️ Utility - Core Mod

### `coremod_includes_mod`

Change to false if your coremod doesn't have a `@Mod` annotation

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** yes
- **Default:** none

### `coremod_plugin_class_name`

You MUST state a class name if you are making a coremod, the class should implement `IFMLLoadingPlugin`

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** yes
- **Default:** none

### `is_coremod`

The most powerful way to change java classes at runtime, it is however very primitive with little documentation. Only make a coremod if you are absolutely sure of what you are doing.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

## 🛠️ Utility - Mixins

### `use_mixins`

Powerful tool to do runtime description changes of classes. Docs: [SpongeForge Wiki](https://github.com/SpongePowered/Mixin/wiki), [MixinBooter Wiki](https://github.com/CleanroomMC/MixinBooter), [CleanroomMC Wiki](https://cleanroommc.com/wiki/forge-mod-development/mixin/preface)

- **Type:** Evaluated String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `false`

### `mixin_booter_version`

Provided by the template via `gradle.properties`

- **Type:** String
- **Required:** yes
- **Default:** none

### `generate_mixin_json`

Generate missing configs from `mixin_configs` (full resource filenames, e.g. `mixins.modid.config_name.json`)

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

### `mixin_configs`

Delimit configs with spaces. Template generation can be toggled via `generate_mixins_json`

- **Type:** List (delimiter `" "`)
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** empty list

### `mixin_connector_class`

Classpath to fully-qualified class implementing `org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.connect.IMixinConnector`. When non-empty, written to the jar manifest as MixinConnector

- **Type:** Evaluated String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `${root_package}.${mod_id}.MixinConnector`

### `mixin_refmap`

A refmap is a JSON that denotes mapping conversions, this JSON is generated automatically, with the name `mixins.mod_id.refmap.json`

- **Type:** Evaluated String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `mixins.${mod_id}.refmap.json`

## 🛠️ Utility - Tags

### `use_tags`

A class is generated at build-time for compilation, to describe property that have values that could change at build time such as versioning. Java uses the RetroFuturaGradle implementation, while Kotlin uses a dynamically generated class.

- **Type:** Boolean
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `true`

### `tag_class_name`

The path where the generated Tags class will be placed. Separators should be dots, e.g. `com.example.project`

- **Type:** Evaluated String
- **Required:** no
- **Default:** `${root_package}.${mod_id}.Tags`
